name: HiBob
tagline: HiBob (Bob) is a modern HRIS designed for mid-size companies with AI features including compensation benchmarking, workforce planning analytics, and an AI HR assistant. It supports flexible working patterns, performance management, and benefits administration with a consumer-grade interface.
